explainedBy: Julia crashes into Damen on the street and goes down; he looks on.

storyboard.claim: Julia crashes into Damen in New York.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Julia falling on a street, Damen standing startled beside her.

explainedBy: Julia reaches down and picks up the abandoned wallet, trying to do right.

storyboard.claim: Julia picks up Will's ugly wallet.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Julia on the street taking a wallet in hand, sad face.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same street; she now picks up the wallet.
storyboard.addedInformation: The deed of picking it up.

explainedBy: Damen looks down on Julia and sneers at her while she holds the wallet.

storyboard.claim: Damen sneers 'Run along, honey' at Julia.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Julia holding the wallet, sad; Damen beside her pointing with a smirk.

explainedBy: Damen deliberately makes Julia feel small with a threat-like warning.

storyboard.claim: Damen tries to make her feel small.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Damen smirking and pointing down at Julia, who shrinks, worried.

explainedBy: Damen towers over Julia physically and socially, big city over Midwest.

storyboard.claim: Damen towers over her.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Low-angle Damen talking down at a slumped Julia.

explainedBy: The host asks the listener to recall feeling insecure in a new place; only a feeling.

storyboard.claim: Think of a time you felt insecure.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Julia alone, worried, shoulders low.
storyboard.addedInformation: weak: a feeling, shown as a face.

explainedBy: Both guard themselves with a shield, and the guarding looks like cruelty; neither gives grace.

storyboard.claim: Guarding looks like cruelty.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Julia and Damen standing stiffly apart, both angry, a shield between them.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Back to the pair; adds the shield.
storyboard.addedInformation: Protection as the root of the coldness.

explainedBy: Grace requires lowering the guard; they will not.

storyboard.claim: Grace requires lowering your guard.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Same two behind the shield, faces tense, neither moves.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same stage; the point is what grace requires.

explainedBy: Grace means acknowledging the other's humanity, hence your own vulnerability.

storyboard.claim: Grace leads to acknowledging your own vulnerability.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A flow: grace to the other's humanity to your own vulnerability.

explainedBy: If you show grace you open a channel and invite connection.

storyboard.claim: Grace opens a channel to connection.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A flow: show grace, open a channel, connection.
storyboard.onScreenText: Show grace / Open a channel / Connection
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Next step of the same argument.

explainedBy: Damen sits at the family table staring at a plate of risotto.

storyboard.claim: Damen sits before the risotto plate.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Damen seated in a room, a plate icon, sad face.

explainedBy: Uncle Remy hated risotto; Damen zones out choking on grief.

storyboard.claim: Damen grieves for the man who understood him.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Same seated Damen, blank stare at the plate.

explainedBy: His parents bicker about balls and financial optics while Damen sits there.

storyboard.claim: His parents bicker and ignore him.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Damen still seated, face closed, plate in front.

explainedBy: Damen offers polite sarcastic compliance, a congenial smile.

storyboard.claim: He smiles the congenial smile of an affable son (forced).
storyboard.concreteVisual: Damen seated with a forced smile.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same table; the face changes to a forced smile.

explainedBy: Sarcasm is a wall protecting grief from parents who call Remy demented.

storyboard.claim: He builds a wall of sarcasm to protect his grief.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Damen smirking with a mask icon.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same Damen; new icon for the pretense.

explainedBy: The dining-room table cruelty extends to the street: cause then effect.

storyboard.claim: Cruelty on the street extends from the dining table.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A flow: dining room table to cruelty to Julia.

explainedBy: He keeps the world at arm's length or the grief will drown him; the host pushes back.

storyboard.claim: He holds everyone back to stop grief drowning him.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Damen afraid, shield up.
storyboard.addedInformation: His fear of letting anyone in.

explainedBy: The second host claims Julia threatens his family's wealth and legacy.

storyboard.claim: Julia is a threat to his family's wealth.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Damen angry beside an inheritance icon.

explainedBy: Her father frames her family as manipulative fraudsters.

storyboard.claim: Her family is framed as fraudsters.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Julia worried with a mask icon.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same argument; what the father said.

explainedBy: Damen protects his territory, the primitive reading.

storyboard.claim: Damen is protecting his territory.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Damen smirking, a shield icon beside him.

explainedBy: The other host disagrees: Damen says he does not care about the money.

storyboard.claim: He does not care about the money.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Damen with a blank, unbothered face.

explainedBy: He is a jerk because he sees she is a disruptor, not because of a bank account.

storyboard.claim: Damen recognizes Julia as a disruptor.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Damen facing Julia, worried, she stands still.

explainedBy: She disrupts his emotional stasis.

storyboard.claim: Julia disrupts his emotional stasis.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A flow: Julia, disruptor, emotional stasis.

explainedBy: Messy, bruised Julia with her ugly wallet is a shock of reality in his curated numb life.

storyboard.claim: Julia is a shock of reality.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Julia holding the wallet, sad, bruised.

explainedBy: She threatens the numbness that keeps him from his pain.

storyboard.claim: Julia threatens his numbness.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A flow: Julia, threatens numbness, feeling his pain.

explainedBy: Her existence makes him feel; that terrifies him.

storyboard.claim: Her existence makes him feel things.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Damen afraid.

explainedBy: Both stand rigidly upright on the sidewalk, heels dug in.

storyboard.claim: Both stand rigid, heels dug in.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Julia and Damen upright and stiff.

explainedBy: Neither tips forward; they refuse the vulnerability of the fall.

storyboard.claim: Neither will tip forward.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Same two, still rigid, worried faces.

explainedBy: One finally tries to bridge the gap but does it wrong.

storyboard.claim: One tries to bridge the gap.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Damen walks toward Julia.

explainedBy: Damen is assigned to tutor Julia in math and decides to leverage it.

storyboard.claim: Damen is assigned to tutor Julia.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Classroom, Damen smirking with a book, Julia beside him.

explainedBy: He leans in so close his curls tickle her nose.

storyboard.claim: Damen leans in close.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Close two-shot, Damen leaning toward uneasy Julia.

explainedBy: He offers a second loaf of bread and whispers 'We'll see.'

storyboard.claim: He offers bread and whispers 'We'll see.'
storyboard.concreteVisual: Damen smirking, talking toward worried Julia; a plate icon.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the tutoring, adds the bread.

explainedBy: He demands an unnamed favor in exchange for help, invading her space.

storyboard.claim: He demands an unnamed favor.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Same pair; Damen leaning toward her, she leaning back.

explainedBy: In this setup he holds 100% of the power.

storyboard.claim: He holds all the power.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A spectrum with the marker at his side.

explainedBy: The hosts name it transactional intimacy.

storyboard.claim: Transactional intimacy.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Damen smirking, name given.
